verdict.rationale: Smithery offered a REST API, so the API-spec axis applies, but the pack has no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec: every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returns 404. The October 31, 2026 shutdown also removed the documented API surface entirely. Per-server server cards and generated TypeScript SDKs describe individual MCP servers, not a machine-readable spec of Smithery's own API, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
